changes: Sign in to your own omi-local server with its address, username and password; change it in Settings → Account. The app talks to that server only.
Removed all third-party analytics and crash reporting (Sentry, PostHog) and the Firebase sign-in; errors are kept in the local log.
New "Waiting for your OK" page: approve tasks, calendar events and day summaries (Approve all, with Undo), and read the day review before approving it. Tasks marks what still waits.
Conversations the server is still processing show "Writing notes…"; chat says "Still working…" and waits up to 20 minutes for a slow local model.
Microphone capture streams to your server's own speech service.
Updates are checked only against a feed you host (OMI_UPDATE_FEED_URL); none by default.
Linux: tray icon, launch at login (XDG autostart), and platform-neutral wording.
